method.metadata: Every XML component field and every numbered physical PCB pad; independently regenerate XML from frozen schematic.
method.copper: Native effective shapes intersected separately per copper layer. Each filled zone contour and its holes is a separate physical item; a zone UUID never joins disconnected islands. Vias/PTH pads connect their actual two copper shapes. No CAD writes.
method.native: Independent ERC and DRC with all-track-errors, schematic-parity and refill in memory; no save-board. Existing two mechanical BT1 NPTH exclusions remain explicit.

documented_exclusions.comment: BT1 locating hole under U1 body; clears module pads and thermal copper; holder peg clearance requires sample fit check
